name: ChEMBL Web Services
summary: Manually curated bioactive molecules with drug-like properties, targets and bioassay data, free over a REST API.
description: ChEMBL holds compounds, drugs, targets, assays, documents and measured activities. The web services expose each as a resource with search, filtering by field lookups and offset pagination. At check, the status endpoint reported ChEMBL_37 (released 2026-05-01) with about 2.9 million distinct compounds, 18,552 targets and 24.5 million activities.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched; no rate-limit headers seen.

endpoints.summary: One molecule with structures, properties and cross references
Bioactivity measurements, filterable by field lookups

agent_notes: The default response format is XML: add .json to the resource or send format=json. List responses wrap results under the resource name plus page_meta (limit, offset, next, total_count); follow page_meta.next. Filter with Django-style lookups, for example activity.json?target_chembl_id=CHEMBL240&standard_type=IC50&limit=5. Ids look like CHEMBL25.
caveats: Default format is XML, which surprises JSON-first clients.
Large unfiltered activity queries are slow; filter first or use the bulk download.
The license statement (CC BY-SA 3.0) was read from the ChEMBL homepage; the share-alike term applies to derived datasets.
